shots.scene: Low-angle street canyon: a small cream paper kid leans back on planted feet, gripping a taut twine tied to an enormous coral paper balloon cropped by the top of frame; the balloon tugs, the kid's heels slide, paper dust drifts; slow upward push-in with a tilted vertical composition.
shots.notes: Beat 1, variant A: scale and weight first. Balloon cropped, hero small. Camera push-in and slight roll; no text.

shots.scene: Insert close-up: two paper hands clamp a rolled-paper handle, the twine knot creaks at the center, a shoe heel digs into a cracked paper sidewalk below; the string jerks upward on the last beat, tearing dust from the fibers.
shots.notes: Beat 1 insert: contact, friction, tension. Handheld micro-shake; blurred street behind. Cut on the upward jerk.

shots.scene: Vertical lift-off: the balloon rips the kid off the pavement; camera tracks up as facades, windows and rooftops slide down in layered parallax, the kid flails then steadies, paper scraps and ghosted trailing shapes mark the acceleration, a foreground cloud wipes the frame at the end.
shots.notes: Beat 2, variant A: rise, inertia, falling city. Camera lags the hero; ghost copies are an imitation of smearing, not real motion blur.

shots.scene: Aerial paper diorama: the balloon hangs high above a layered cut-paper city; the kid dangles from the handle, looks down in awe, then pulls his knees up and grips with both hands as the camera eases back and a paper cloud clears the foreground.
shots.notes: Beat 3, variant A part 1: reveal scale of the city; high-altitude vertical composition; camera crane/back with cloud match cut.

shots.scene: The kid sits on the balloon crown, legs dangling, one hand on the crown strap, the long twine curling down toward the city; he throws both arms up, the camera cranes out to reveal the whole balloon and the paper city below, then the frame fades.
shots.notes: Beat 3, variant A part 2: resolution and iconic final frame. Camera pull-out reveals scale; long string sells height.
